verdict.rationale: xAI's models docs have a 'Model Aliases' section stating that `<modelname>` tracks the latest stable version and `<modelname>-latest` tracks the latest version, alongside pinned versioned IDs. The GET /v1/models endpoint exposes an `aliases` field, and dated migration guides document what happens to retired slugs (they redirect to grok-4.3). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that pinned IDs stay stable, explicit examples mapping each alias to its current versioned ID, and a guarantee that pinned versions are not silently redirected once retired.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pin an exact versioned model ID while aliases track the latest release, with the alias-to-version policy documented

citations.quote: `<modelname>` is aliased to the latest stable version. `<modelname>-latest` is aliased to the latest version
List all models available to the authenticating API key, including model names (ID), creation times, and pricing
requests to the retired model slugs above will automatically redirect to `grok-4.3`
